name: Dimethylheptylpyran
summary: Dimethylheptylpyran (DMHP) is a synthetic cannabinoid and analogue of tetrahydrocannabinol (THC). It was invented in 1949 during attempts to elucidate the structure of Δ9-THC, one of the active components of cannabis. DMHP is a pale yellow, viscous oil which is insoluble in water but dissolves in alcohol or non-polar solvents.

pharmacology.text: It is thought to act as a CB1 receptor agonist, in a similar manner to other cannabinoid derivatives. While DMHP itself has been subject to relatively little study since the characterization of the cannabinoid receptors, the structural isomer 1,2-dimethylheptyl-Δ8-THC has been shown to be a highly potent cannabinoid agonist, and the activity of its enantiomers has been studied separately.

uses.en: It has no medical use and is known only from laboratory and animal research on cannabinoids.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，只出現在大麻素的實驗室與動物研究中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，只出现在大麻素的实验室与动物研究中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Potent synthetic cannabinoids as a class can cause a racing heart, a sharp drop in blood pressure on standing, dizziness, anxiety, confusion and vomiting.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。強效合成大麻素作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、起身時血壓驟降、頭暈、焦慮、混亂與嘔吐。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。强效合成大麻素作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、起身时血压骤降、头晕、焦虑、混乱与呕吐。

fact.en: This compound, also called DMHP, was made in 1949 by the American chemist Roger Adams while he was working out the structure of THC. It is a pale yellow oil that will not dissolve in water.
fact.zh: 這個化合物又稱 DMHP，是美國化學家 Roger Adams 於 1949 年在研究 THC 結構時合成的。它是一種不溶於水的淡黃色油狀物。
fact.zhHans: 这个化合物又称 DMHP，是美国化学家 Roger Adams 于 1949 年在研究 THC 结构时合成的。它是一种不溶于水的淡黄色油状物。
